Hi! I need some help with a couple of things. I recently moved to a new house on Elm Avenue here in Houston. I noticed that one of my recent orders was sent to my old address, and I want to make sure it gets sent to my new place instead. Also, I’d like to update my default address in your system to the new one. You should be able to see both addresses in my order history, so I’d prefer not to share them directly. 

And one more thing—I’d like to exchange my tablet for the cheapest model you have, since I’m trying to save money after the move. Can you help me with all of this?

Sure! My name is Sophia Martin and my email is sophia.martin4832@example.com. Let me know if you need anything else to pull up my orders—I’d really prefer not to share my address or zip code since you should be able to see my recent orders and addresses on file.

Thanks for pulling up my info! Here’s what I’d like to do:

1. Please update the shipping address for the order that’s currently set to 592 Elm Avenue. That’s my old address, and I want it sent to my new place instead.
2. I’d like my default address updated to the new one as well (the one you have on file for my recent luggage order).
3. For the tablet, yes, I want to exchange my current one for the cheapest model you mentioned (8-inch, 128GB, gold). If there’s a refund, please process it to my original payment method.

Let me know if you need anything else from me!
Yes, that’s all correct! Please go ahead and make those changes for me. Thank you so much for your help!
Yes, please proceed with all of those actions. That covers everything I need for now! Thanks again.

That’s good to know—thanks for updating the addresses! I’ll wait for the tablet to be delivered before requesting the exchange. For now, that’s everything I needed. Appreciate your help! 

###STOP###
